description:
🌿 Brand Introduction

The Rooted Fern is a boutique accessories brand inspired by forests, florals, and quiet, intentional living. We design nature inspired satchels, bags, and combat boots for those who feel most at home outdoors, in a garden, or with a good book.

Every piece is thoughtfully designed to blend everyday function with timeless, nature driven style. With each order, a tree is planted, allowing our customers to make a small but meaningful environmental impact.

🌿 Product Description

Our products are crafted using high quality vegan leather and durable materials designed for everyday wear. Each collection draws inspiration from the natural world- woodland textures, botanical prints, and seasonal landscapes.

The Evergreen Collection features year round staples designed to be both practical and beautiful. All pieces are made to order to reduce overproduction and support a more intentional approach to fashion.

🌿 Why The Rooted Fern Stands Out

• Nature inspired designs not found in mass retail
• Vegan leather and cruelty-free materials
• A tree planted with every order
• Made to order production that reduces excess waste
• Boutique aesthetic with collectible seasonal releases

🌿 Commission & Payment

Affiliates earn 10% commission on all referred sales through their unique link. Payments are issued monthly via PayPal with no minimum payout threshold.

🌿 What Our Ambassadors Receive

• Early access to new collections
• Exclusive updates and private group access
• Custom discount codes for their audience
• Support, resources, and marketing materials

We are looking for creators who genuinely connect with nature inspired style and share thoughtfully curated content.
